extracted.intended_audience: preclinical researchers and translational scientists working on porcine-to-primate xenotransplantation and transplant immunology
extracted.subtask_description: Design, execution, and evaluation criteria for porcine kidney-to-cynomolgus monkey xenotransplantation preclinical studies, including donor/recipient selection, genetic engineering validation, functional assays, histopathology scoring and endpoint criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient selection by preformed antibody binding
rubrics_metrics.description: A cohort of cynomolgus monkeys was screened for porcine-reactive preformed antibody binding; monkeys with lower antibody binding to 3KO AECs or KECs were selected as recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection was empirical (availability-limited) and guided by measured anti-porcine IgG/IgM binding; low-binding animals prioritized to reduce early humoral complications (see Extended Data Fig. 6a–d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grouping of donor genotypes for analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given similar performance of KECs isolated from 3KO.7TG or 3KO.7TG.RI donors in functional assays, transplants with 3KO kidneys with and without RI were analysed as one group and 3KO.7TG and 3KO.7TG.RI kidneys as a second group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This grouping reduces comparisons when functional assay performance is indistinguishable across certain engineered variants; used to calculate survival and other outcome statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Survival analysis methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Survival probability was compared between groups using Kaplan–Meier curves and statistical analysis performed using a log-rank test (reported P = 0.026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use log-rank test for comparing graft survival distributions; report median survival times and P-values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Euthanasia criterion based on serum creatinine
rubrics_metrics.description: Creatinine levels above 6 mg dl−1 meet criteria for euthanasia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serum creatinine is monitored post-transplant; dashed lines in figures indicate normal range and values >6 mg dl−1 trigger humane end point euthanasia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Histopathological assessment using Banff classification with xenotransplantation adaptations
rubrics_metrics.description: Rejection was assessed by histopathological examination based on the Banff classification of renal allograft pathology, with modifications for xenotransplantation; pathology samples were assessed with a 'xenotransplantation-adapted' criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adaptations address xenotransplant-specific mechanisms (e.g., species coagulation, complement incompatibilities). See Extended Data Table 1 and Supplementary Table 6 for the adapted scoring and diagnostic rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition and scoring of specific pathologies (ATI, AMR/TMA, TCMR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pathology scoring explicitly identifies acute tubular injury (ATI), antibody-mediated rejection (AMR)/thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA), TMA alone, and T cell–mediated rejection (TCMR) as distinct findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ATI is noted as a general kidney injury feature (not in Banff); in xenotransplantation, TMA may reflect antibody-mediated, drug-related, or species coagulation/complement incompatibility even without de novo donor-specific antibody (dnDSA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of C4d staining
rubrics_metrics.description: C4d-positive staining in glomeruli indicates C4 activation and may be expected in 3KO.7TG ± RI samples in the presence of dnDSA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: C4d staining location (glomeruli vs peritubular capillaries) informs mechanism; positive glomerular C4d suggests complement activation upstream of CD46/CD55 interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment of lymphocyte depletion and dnDSA monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Lymphocyte depletion in blood was demonstrated by measuring circulating B cell and T cell counts; dnDSA reactive to 3KO endothelial cells was monitored over time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although B cell depletion may be robust, dnDSA can still develop (observed in 8 of 18 transplants); correlate dnDSA presence with pathological features of antibody-mediated graft injury.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immunosuppression regimen components and considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients received induction therapy with B and T lymphocyte depletion, maintenance therapy with anti-CD154 antibody and mycophenolate mofetil, and a brief post-transplant course of tacrolimus and steroids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consideration of other approaches (e.g., anti-CD19 depletion, desensitization, plasmapheresis, plasma cell therapies) is discussed; CD40–CD40L pathway agents are standard in NHP xenotransplantation though not yet FDA-approved.

rubrics_metrics.name: IHC imaging and quantification protocol for transgene expression
rubrics_metrics.description: Expression of human transgene proteins was assessed using tyramide signal amplification IHC, imaged with identical scanning parameters, and analysed with Zeiss Zen Blue 3.4 to produce mean fluorescent intensities (MFIs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whole-tissue contours drawn for MFI; for glomeruli/blood vessels select 20 glomeruli and 8 vessels (whole tissue) or 5–10 glomeruli and 3–5 vessels (biopsies) with equal distribution; tubular MFI from 20 rectangles (500×500 px) or 5–10 rectangles (300×300 px) for biopsies. Reported MFI = normalized average MFI (average positive control minus average negative control).

rubrics_metrics.name: Normalization of IHC MFI values
rubrics_metrics.description: Normalized average MFI is defined as the average MFI values of the positive controls minus the average MFI values of the negative controls (nonspecific signal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positive controls use primary antibody plus HRP and Cy5-tyramide; negative controls incubated with HRP and Cy5-tyramide only. Use same scanning parameters across samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: CRISPR guide RNA design strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The R library DECIPHER was used to design guide RNAs; one sgRNA per gene targeted GGTA1, CMAH, and B4GALNT2/B4GALNT2L, and an sgRNA targeted the AAVS1 locus for landing pad insertion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guide sequences provided in Supplementary Table 2; all sgRNAs synthesized by Synthego. For PERV pol targeting, DECIPHER-guided sgRNAs targeted the catalytic core of pol.

rubrics_metrics.name: RNP formation and electroporation protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: An sgRNA was incubated with Cas9 enzyme to form the RNP complex immediately before use; for multiplexed knockouts and landing pad insertion, donor plasmid was added to RNP complexes before electroporation using Neon Transfection System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow manufacturer instructions for RNP formation; electroporation parameters and kit (MPK10096, Thermo Fisher) specified in methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clonal isolation and genotyping criteria after editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Five days post-electroporation, cells were sorted into single cells gated on absence of α-Gal glycan and presence of mTagBFP2 marker, placed into 96-well plates, and clonal populations genotyped to identify correct 3KO edits and landing pad insertion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subsequently replace landing pad by PL15S via Cre-mediated cassette exchange, sort on expression of payload genes (CD46, CD55, PROCR, THBD, CD47), and genotype clones before using in SCNT for pig cloning.

rubrics_metrics.name: PERV copy number determination
rubrics_metrics.description: Droplet digital PCR assay designed against the pol gene was used to determine PERV copy number; the Yucatan 25 female line was found to carry 59 copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amplicon sequencing used to identify clonal populations carrying indel mutations in all copies for PERV inactivation.

rubrics_metrics.name: C3b deposition assay conditions and readout
rubrics_metrics.description: Endothelial cells incubated with 25% pooled normal human serum or cynomolgus serum for 30 min at 37 °C; negative control uses 25% serum containing 10 mM EDTA to inactivate complement; stained with anti-C3b and analysed by flow cytometry, plotted as MFI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Ghost Dye viability stain, acquire immediately on BD FACSymphony A3, analyse in FlowJo; perform duplicates and report MFI values with appropriate statistical tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complement-dependent cytotoxicity assay readout and normalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Adherent endothelial cells treated with 25% diluted sera containing Cytotox Red viability dye and imaged over time; Cytotox Red-positive cell counts normalized to total cell counts to calculate percent Cytotox Red-positive (complement-dependent cytotoxicity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seed 3,000 cells/well in 96-well plates; use Incucyte live-cell analysis for time course; manual total cell counts from phase contrast images; plot percent positive over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activated protein C (aPC) functional assay protocol and quantification
rubrics_metrics.description: Cells incubated with blocking antibodies (RCR-252 and/or PBS-01) then treated with thrombin and protein C; hirudin used to quench thrombin; supernatants transferred to plate with aPC standard curve; Spectrozyme PCa chromogenic substrate used and absorbance at 405 nm measured to compute initial velocity and determine aPC concentrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use specified reagent concentrations (e.g., 40 µg ml−1 RCR-252, 4 µg ml−1 PBS-01, 0.1 U ml−1 thrombin, 150 nM protein C); calculate initial slope and interpolate from standard curve to report aPC concentration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole-blood TAT complex assay procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Fresh whole blood collected with 0.5 U ml−1 heparin; 225 µl added to adherent cells and incubated 40 min at 37 °C; plasma collected post-centrifugation and frozen; TAT concentrations measured using ELISA with standard curve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Baseline TAT measured from blood centrifuged concurrently; follow ELISA manufacturer instructions and calculate concentrations from standard curve.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIRPα reporter assay to assess CD47 function
rubrics_metrics.description: Porcine KECs incubated with or without increasing concentrations of anti-human CD47 blocking antibody followed by addition of Jurkat SIRPα reporter cells; luminescence measured after 24 h as readout of CD47–SIRPα signaling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PathHunter Jurkat SIRPα Signaling Bioassay Kit and follow kit instructions for signal detection; plot relative luminescence units and apply appropriate statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caspase 3/7 apoptosis assay conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Endothelial cells treated with 50 ng ml−1 recombinant human TNF overnight; 10,000 cells assayed with Caspase-Glo 3/7 reagent and luminescence read after 30 min to quantify caspase activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure cells ~70% confluent at TNF treatment; follow Promega Caspase-Glo kit instructions; plot activity and use statistical analysis software.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measured glomerular filtration rate (mGFR) by iohexol clearance
rubrics_metrics.description: Single IV dose of iohexol (Omnipaque 300) at 64.7 mg kg−1 with blood sampling at 5, 15, 30 min and 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 10, 24 h; iohexol measured by HPLC-UV; clearance calculated using two-compartmental model and normalized to body surface area (BSA) where BSA (m2) = 9 × BW2/3/100.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Phoenix WinNonlin software for pharmacokinetic modelling; report mGFR as ml min−1 m−2 and provide sampling schedule and assay method details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primate anti-porcine IgG and IgM flow-cytometry assay parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Endothelial cells (1 × 105 per test) incubated with serum diluted 1:4 in PBS with 1% BSA at 4 °C for 30 min; secondary F(ab')2 anti-human IgG or IgM conjugates used; cells fixed and acquired within 3 days; MFI evaluated in duplicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include pooled cynomolgus and human serum controls; analyse with FlowJo and plot MFI data with statistical tests; maintain consistent secondary antibody dilutions and acquisition settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of standardized statistical and plotting software
rubrics_metrics.description: Data were plotted and statistics calculated using GraphPad Prism v8.2.0 (and other specified tools like Phoenix WinNonlin for PK modelling).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State software versions and statistical tests used (e.g., log-rank test for survival); present P-values and appropriate summary statistics.
